about: The real target of each record Cloudflare proxies (scripts/dns-zone build lists them under needs_target, because the export holds Cloudflare's address, not the origin). A key is '<name> <type>' as needs_target names it; the value is the record Route 53 gets instead: {"type": ..., "values": [...], "ttl": ...}. Example: "media.openuniversity.si. CNAME": {"type": "CNAME", "values": ["d1234abcd.cloudfront.net."], "ttl": 300}, the media stack's DistributionDomain.
